data.title: 天雨亚子 · 晨曦微澜的薄被晨起
data.description: 清晨的薄曦漫过整洁的窗纱，洒在深色床榻上。亚子侧卧在柔软被窝中，真丝细吊带滑落单肩，露出一片温润雪肤与锁骨。刚刚醒来的管理官揉了揉有些发涩的眼角，双马尾在枕上铺开，看着近在眼前的身影，她红着脸将薄被往上拉了拉，娇嗔地提醒今天还有一整天的行程要准时出发。
data.location: peaceful private bedroom in soft morning daylight
data.action: lying on side amidst rumpled bedding, silk camisole slipping off one shoulder, pulling sheet up slightly, blushing tenderly while looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft golden morning sunbeams filtering through sheer white drapes
data.mood: flustered domestic morning charm, heartfelt intimacy
data.promptProse: Waking up on a soft bed as morning sunbeams filter through the curtains, Ako lies in a dark silk camisole slipping over her shoulder. She pulls the sheets up with flushed cheeks, her blue eyes filled with warm morning affection.
data.animaCaption: Ako waking up on bed in a dark silk camisole, pulling up sheets with a flustered blush.
